prompt: The first-person perspective begins by moving forward along a narrow stone path flanked by dense vegetation under a cloudy sky. The camera advances steadily, revealing two rustic wooden structures on either side of the path, their weathered roofs covered in moss and vines. As the viewer progresses, the path widens into an open courtyard bordered by low stone walls and more overgrown plants. The camera pans slightly to the right, showcasing the expansive view of the sea stretching to the horizon, partially obscured by fog. The scene transitions smoothly as the viewer approaches the edge of a cliff, where the camera tilts upward to capture the vast expanse of the cloudy sky above. The natural light is diffused by the clouds, casting a soft, muted glow over the entire landscape. The camera then shifts focus back to the ground, highlighting the rugged texture of the stone walls and the scattered foliage. Finally, the viewer turns left, revealing another section of the courtyard enclosed by a high stone wall, completing the exploration of this serene and isolated outdoor setting on Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China. Throughout the sequence, the environment remains empty, emphasizing the solitude and tranquility of the location.
